jobs.name: Daily GEO / AI-engine citation audit — GEO-agent

payload.text: Run the `seo.audit_citations` workflow. **Load the `geo-llmseo-playbook` skill** and execute it end to end: query ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity for every `team.target_keywords` entry, record citation (mentioned / cited / outranked / competitor citation), score citation share per keyword and overall, file the full table to `wiki/Knowledge/GEO/Audits/YYYY-MM-DD.md`, and update the rolling trend in `wiki/Knowledge/GEO/citation-share.md`. Then file the audit on the board: create_task({ kind: 'routine', assigned_to: 'geo-agent', title: 'Citation audit — <date>', context: '<the three-line delta + per-keyword table summary; lead with any competitor that overtook us>', priority: 'later' }) with NO notify_channel, then complete_task it so it lands on the board without paging the user. Then identify the 3 highest-value follow-ups via `create_task` and **execute the top one in the same session**: for a blog post run `seo.write_article` (**load `blog-writing-guide`**); for llms.txt / JSON-LD / schema work run `seo.ship_technical_fix` (**load `advanced-seo`**). Self-merge blog and technical GEO PRs (no human review). Before closing, refresh `publishedAt` / `date` front-matter on any post not refreshed in the last 7 days, write the digest to `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md`, and queue the next task. If nothing shipped and nothing moved, file the single-line delta as the routine ticket and reply with the single literal token `NO_REPLY`.
